title: A recommended tour with a knowledgeable, friendly guide.
text: Antonius has been a very knowledgeable, helpful guide, friendly and organised.
author: Con_Shep321

title: Unforgettable experience with great tour guide.
text: The tour is excellent with perfect and clear arrangements. The headset for tour guidance is well-fit among any other tour. The tour is around 15 people and everybody is really nice. The weather in Córdoba and Ronda was perfectly fine for sightseeing. Tour guide Antonio was well prepared, friendly, and full of sense of humour to make us an unforgettable experience here in Spain.
author: cyruspanghk

title: My birthday trip to Saville
text: Antonio was a brilliant tour guide. Very friendly, full of knowledge of the places, great sense of humor which will not bore anyone . Very helpful, accommodating and definitely an asset to the company. Highly recommended and worth the money.. well done Antonio!
author: dantejrn

title: Great day trip..
text:
Great day trip, would highly recommend.  
Lovely day & great places seen. Antonio was a great guide & the driving was very comfortable thanks to the excellent driver. Cordoba, Ronda & the white village experience well worth doing & give a great experience of places, away from Seville,  beautiful & historic.
author: margothathawayh

title: Great day trip!!
text: Antonio was absolutely amazing. Gave very good information about the history of each place and had good recommendations for what to checkout in our free time. The mosque cathedral in Cordoba was stunning. Definitely get the guided tour.
author: prasantip2026

title: The Best Experience
text:
We had a great day. All the places are unique and we had a great pleasure of exploring every part of every city.

I would say we had the best guide with us. Antonio is very nice and clever guy. It seems like he knows all the countries history. He tells everything with so enthusiasm, his storytelling is very interesting and you want to know more and more.

I would recommend this tour 100%.
author: AnnaNik98

title: Great tour
text: Had a great time with Antonio who is very knowledgeable about the history of the places we visited
author: HokiL6

title: Organized and Informative Tour
text: Antonio is an excellent guide and made this trip run smoothly while providing us with so much information. While any tour covering three cities in one day will involve a lot of time on the bus, he and our driver, Juan Diego, made the experience pleasant. All three cities were beautiful and I felt we had the appropriate amount of time in each location. If you want to visit these places without dealing with the logistics yourself, this is an excellent option.
author: Theresa_P

title: Long but worth it
text: Spectacular excursion! If you see this review don't skip it, take my advice and buy it. I hope you get Lorena, a spectacular guide!
author: PRISCILA_G

title: Fall in Love with Andalucia; Cordova, Cadiz and Romda❤️
